page.layout: One text column of running text, with no marginal notes and no footnotes. Running head at the top, page number at the upper left, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: permittit evenire, quæ à Revelato Dei Verbo (
solâ Bonæ Conscientiæ & Actionum clara,
statâ, tutâ Regula ) multum abest ut compro-
Atque adeo confido, Caufæ meæ Justitiâ
& Conscientiæ Rectitudine Me tanto Illis fu-
turum in Foro Dei superiorem, quanto Illos
supra Me extulit Fortuna in illo Vulgi judi-
cio; qui non cogitat plurima sæpe hominum
facinora ad Cælos usque attolli plausu mundi,
qui si ex injustitia & scelerato fine censean-
tur, ex Inferno ascendunt: Quin nec Aura illa
secunda quæ Piratæ velum implet, statim
ipsius latrocinia & rapinas excusat.
Multo interim libentius & alacrius fero per-
didisse hanc litem (quam coactus admodum
sufcepi, ad affercendas Leges Regni, Libertatem
& Honorem Parlamentarium, Jura Coronæ,
justas Subditorum Immunitates, & veram Re-
ligionem Christianam in Doctrina, Disciplina,
cæterisque incitamentis & præmiis debitis)
quàm si multo Bello potiori ad hæc omnia op-
primenda valuissem; id quod nonnulli jam pa-
lam faciunt, quicquid priùs simulaverant.
Plurimum interim mihi proderit Patientia
amicorum & Preces ad mitigandam hujus po-
culi amaritudinem, quam ut à Dei manu (si fic
fieri necesse fit) libentius accipiô & haurio,
quàm ab illis porrigitur eâ sæva & impia ma-
nu contra Me toties levatâ.
In his autem extremis, plus Hostibus videor
quàm Amicis debere: illi finem imponent

page.notes: Running head is set in Greek capitals; the printed Greek is read as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ, with the third-from-last letter group possibly Λ printed in a form close to A. Catchword "ærumnosæ" stands alone at the right below the last line and is the first word of the next page. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Several words are set in a different face (italic) and are marked accordingly where the type is clearly distinct; the exact extent of italics in the lines around "Me", "Illis" and "Cælos" is judged from the scan.
